name: Spirit Blooms with Shields...
desc: A strange plant that coexists with kuuvahki energy. When <color=#FFE14BFF>Suffused with kuuvahki</color>, it will deploy a strong shield which is capable of blocking attacks from outside to a certain extent, as well as knock back the Abyssal Monsters that get too close. At the same time, objects that are susceptible to kuuvahki within the shield will remain <color=#FFE14BFF>Suffused</color>.

imgDesc.text:
A strange plant that coexists with kuuvahki energy. When
Suffused with kuuvahki, it will deploy a strong shield which is capable of blocking attacks from outside to a certain extent, as well as knock back the Abyssal Monsters that get too close. At the same time, objects that are susceptible to kuuvahki within the shield will remain
Suffused.

When Abyssal threats are nearby,
Suffused Mandragora(s) will actively move toward Spirit Bloom(s) and charge them, causing them to become
Suffused and deploy a shield. The Mandragora will then take cover beneath the Spirit Bloom's shield until the threat is gone.
